title: Authority Crosswalk & Achievement/Learning/Practice Taxonomy
objective: Implement ALP-01 only: a read-only authority crosswalk and deterministic taxonomy that distinguishes recognition, teaching/mastery evidence, campaign accomplishment, practice/training context and mechanical reward references without awarding achievements or mutating owning systems.

rules: ALP-01 creates classification and authority-reference contracts only; it does not define ALP-02 achievement criteria or evidence schemas.
Platform learning/mastery milestones and GM-authored campaign achievements remain distinct in scope, authorship and authority.
Practice/training markers describe optional learning context and cannot create success, advancement, skill, proficiency or capability by implication.
Recognition records may reference evidence and outcomes but cannot silently award themselves.
Mechanically meaningful rewards are references only in ALP-01 and may commit only through their owning Reward, Progression, Reputation or Faction authority.
Achievements and learning milestones are optional and never universal permission or capability gates.
Unknown, hidden or unobserved completion evidence remains unresolved; AI may explain or propose but cannot infer completion.
Taxonomy projection is deterministic, stable under input ordering and provenance-preserving.
ALP-01 creates no durable persistence, migration 0022, provider activation, tester distribution, release or deployment.
